audit.whatIsWrong: The page reads as an even lane ('Even matchup', chart mostly Fiora) while the data says Fiora is losing it.
audit.why: 46.64% over 654 games is a losing matchup, and the page's own whys/mid/late text already says levels 2-5 and both item stages are Wukong's.
audit.corrected: Left diff/diffRating alone (6/10 with 46.6% is defensible) but corrected the level chart so the page stops claiming stages Fiora does not own.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Fiora levels 2, 3, first item and 2+ items and gave level 6 to Skill — the exact inverse of the packet chart and of the page's own prose.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Skill/Wukong/Wukong/Wukong/Fiora/Wukong/Wukong. mid opens 'This is his window, not yours', whys[4] says level 6 is 'the one stage you clearly own', late says he reclaims it with items.
audit.corrected: win[1..3] to Wukong, win[4] to Fiora, win[5..6] to Wukong, with the matching full phases sides/ratings flipped as one group.

audit.whatIsWrong: Crushing Blow's auto-attack reset is never stated, and the Warrior Trickster do-line carried generic trade text instead of the decoy mechanic its title promises.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags autoreset-burst-tell: his combo opens with an auto reset, so the wind-up — not the cast bar — is the cue to step out. The decoy is what baits a wasted Riposte, which is this page's whole premise.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[1].d now states the auto reset tell; dosFull[1].d now states the decoy/stealth mechanic.

audit.why: Plain grammar error in shipped prose.

edits.before: Q-lunge the exposed vital on Wukong, AA once, and E-slow out — repeat until his bar forces the all-in he loses.
edits.after: Warrior Trickster leaves a decoy and stealths the real body — hold Riposte until you see which one swings.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Crushing Blow is an auto reset — the wind-up is your cue to step out.

edits.before: His Black Cleaver plus Stone Skin armor stacking out-bruisers you in extended fights — chunk him with Vitals and disengage, do not extend.
edits.after: His Black Cleaver plus Stone Skin armor stacking out-bruises you in extended fights — chunk him with Vitals and disengage, never extend.
